title: Prime Minister Pays Tribute to Former PM Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru on His Birth Anniversary
body_text: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today paid tributes to former Prime Minister Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru on the occasion of his birth anniversary. The Prime Minister shared on X: "Paying tribute to former PM Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru on his birth anniversary." Paying tribute to former PM Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru on his birth anniversary. — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) November 14, 2026 ***** MJPS/SS/PRK
